description: Tier-1 <each> per-row if= STRUCTURAL absence at CREATE time (SPEC §17.1). Two keyed rows; id=2 seeds on:false, so its <li> is NOT in the DOM at first paint (removed, not display:none). Pins the create-time absence half: the assertion whose absence let three divergent lowerings sit green — a false row leaves only a <!--scrml-if-row--> comment, so .row count is 1 not 2.
rationale: §17.1 an if=false per-row element does not exist in the DOM. With no reactive input the create-time gate must already yield exactly one .row (Alice); Bob is absent. domAnchored COUNT (not whole-tree dom) because a false row now leaves a comment placeholder.
